purpose: Bundled fictional adult photographs for automatically looping editing-tool demonstrations

photos.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: a sample photograph for video-editor effect and transition demonstration cards. Create a natural editorial photo of a fictional adult Black woman with short curly hair, wearing an orange jacket over a white shirt, waist up, walking along a bright modern city street. Clear human facial detail, natural skin texture, saturated but realistic daylight, legible architectural background with depth, no motion blur. No text, logos, borders or collage. Return one photograph.
